toolsets.desc: Provides tools for querying and inspecting Data Registries.

tools.desc: Returns the names of all registered Data Registries. @param StructFilter If non-null, only registries whose item struct inherits from this struct are returned. @return A list of registry names.
Returns detailed information about a specific registry. @param RegistryName The registry name. @return Detailed info including description and id format.
Returns the item struct schema as JSON. @param RegistryName The registry name. @return A JSON string describing the struct's fields and types.
Returns all item names in a Data Registry. @param RegistryName The registry name. @return All item names defined on the registry, in registry order.

Returns the editor-defined sources configured on a Data Registry. These are the sources as authored on the registry asset, before any runtime expansion of meta sources. @param RegistryName The registry name. @return A list of source summaries, in definition order.

Returns the runtime sources for a Data Registry. This is the expanded list including transient child sources generated from meta sources. Will equal ListDataSources when the registry has no meta sources. @param RegistryName The registry name. @return A list of source summaries, in runtime order.

Returns cached item data. Items must be loaded in the registry cache to be returned. @param RegistryName The registry name. @param ItemNames Item names to retrieve. @return A map from item name to its struct data. Names that were not found in the cache are simply omitted from the result.
tools.signature: UDataRegistryTools.GetItems(const FString&, const TArray<FString>&) -> TMap<FString, FInstancedStruct>
